title: InvalidHandle: cannot use Destroyable because destruction was requested in rclpy: services destroyed in their own callback, subscriptions destroyed from another thread and the fixes, measured
excerpt: When rclpy raises InvalidHandle and the executor stops: destroy_service in its own callback failed 15/15 and a one-shot timer fixed it 15/15. Subscriptions destroyed from another thread under MultiThreadedExecutor, one callback group each, failed 5/5 on Humble. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
